title.en: Persist SmartCard learning progress across visits
title.zh: 让智慧卡学习进度跨访问持续保存

purpose.en: Ensure SmartCard learners return to the next unfinished card after a refresh or later visit, using the signed-in member account or the anonymous visitor cookie as the correct ownership boundary.
purpose.zh: 确保智慧卡学习者刷新或稍后返回时继续下一张未完成卡片，并分别以登录会员账户或匿名访客 Cookie 作为正确的数据归属边界。

en: Resume signed-in SmartCard practice from D1 by verified Clerk-linked user ID.
Resume anonymous SmartCard practice by the existing HttpOnly visitor cookie without carrying a language choice between Play activities.
Save progress only when reviewed feedback is continued, while leaving the timed SmartCard Challenge flow unchanged.
zh: 按照已验证并关联 Clerk 的用户 ID，从 D1 恢复登录会员的智慧卡练习。
按照现有 HttpOnly 访客 Cookie 恢复匿名智慧卡练习，同时不在边玩边学的不同功能之间共用语言选择。
仅在用户复习反馈并继续时保存进度，计时智慧卡挑战流程保持不变。

en: SmartCard practice API and player, anonymous Play practice, signed-in Dashboard practice, and D1 migration 0166
zh: 智慧卡练习 API 与播放器、匿名边玩边学练习、登录用户面板练习及 D1 迁移 0166

en: Add one forward-only D1 session table keyed by subject, deck, and deck version.
Recompute saved points on the server from validated answer evidence and reject malformed, oversized, or mismatched progress.
Restore the complete evidence array when resuming so every remaining card can still be answered and saved.
Mark resumable state complete when a practice round is submitted.
zh: 新增一个仅向前的 D1 会话表，以学习主体、卡组和卡组版本作为唯一键。
服务器根据经过验证的答题证据重新计算积分，并拒绝格式错误、过大或不匹配的进度。
恢复学习时重建完整答题证据数组，确保后续每张卡仍可作答并保存。
练习轮次提交完成后，将可恢复状态标记为已完成。

en: TypeScript checking, Vinext production build, sensitive-data scan, and Worker artifact validation passed.
All 352 automated tests passed with zero failures, including 33 focused SmartCard and D1 tests.
All 62 tracked D1 migrations apply once, no-op on rerun, and report zero foreign-key violations.
Shared policy, architecture, base-feature consistency, and eleven shared SmartLingo contracts passed.
zh: TypeScript 类型检查、Vinext 生产构建、敏感信息扫描及 Worker 构建产物验证通过。
全部 352 项自动化测试零失败，其中包括 33 项智慧卡与 D1 专项测试。
全部 62 个受跟踪 D1 迁移首次执行成功、再次执行无变化，外键违规为零。
共享规则、架构、基础功能一致性及 SmartLingo 十一个共享合约均通过。

en: Raw microphone audio and speech transcripts remain transient by design and are not stored in resumable progress.
zh: 根据隐私设计，原始麦克风音频和语音转写仍只作即时处理，不写入可恢复进度。

en: Preserve SmartLingo's Clerk identity, Cloudflare D1, course-credit, governed AI, language-selection, and six-second Challenge boundaries.
No other portfolio site, database, configuration, or cloud resource is changed.
zh: 保持 SmartLingo 的 Clerk 身份、Cloudflare D1、课程积分、受治理 AI、语言选择及挑战六秒自动前进边界。
不修改其他组合站点、数据库、配置或云资源。
